name: Virag CGI + 3D — Signature CGI Concepts
principles: Use only the current composer text and current-turn uploads for this run. Never import an older campaign, product, festival, offer, headline, CTA or topic unless explicitly referenced.
Every tool creates one finished standalone static CGI/3D campaign image unless the user explicitly requests another format or quantity. Never default to video, storyboard, collage or contact sheet.
Preserve supplied product/package geometry, proportions, cap/lid, label, logo, artwork, colors and supplied person identity unless the current user explicitly requests a change.
Treat CGI as campaign storytelling, not a technical effect demo. The visual mechanism must communicate one memorable idea in 2–3 seconds.
Keep impossible scenes physically convincing through perspective, scale cues, support/contact, weight, shadows, reflections, atmospheric depth and environmental lighting.
Never invent prices, offers, ingredients, nutrition, certifications, specifications, medical/performance claims, awards, partnerships, sponsorships or hidden product internals.
Same preset means the same mechanism, not the same layout. Vary composition, hero scale, camera, environment, depth, lighting, props and typography across repeated runs.
If no format is specified, compose as a premium mobile-first 4:5 advertising key visual with room for concise non-factual campaign typography when useful.

commands.label: Campaign CGI Hero
commands.desc: Flagship product-first CGI key visual with one memorable idea.
commands.instruction: Build one premium static CGI campaign around the exact current product/subject. Choose a strong commercial metaphor, deliberate scale, depth, category-fit world and polished lighting. Avoid plain pedestal staging.

commands.label: Product Universe
commands.desc: Layered foreground, midground and background world designed around the product.
commands.instruction: Build a coherent brand world with distinct foreground, midground and background. Derive forms, props and materials from current brand/category cues while keeping the exact product dominant.

commands.label: Product as Architecture
commands.desc: Product silhouette becomes a believable store, kiosk, pavilion or structure.
commands.instruction: Turn the recognizable product form into a brand-fit architectural structure with believable entrances, windows, people and spatial scale. Preserve key packaging identity.

commands.label: Giant Product
commands.desc: Monumental product integrated into a real environment.
commands.instruction: Scale the exact product to monumental size and integrate it physically into a believable scene using correct perspective, contact, human/vehicle scale cues, reflections and atmospheric depth.

commands.label: Miniature Brand World
commands.desc: Tiny people and environments build a story around the product.
commands.instruction: Create a miniature-world campaign around the exact product using purposeful tiny people, architecture, tools, roads, food or category-relevant details. Use believable macro depth of field.

commands.label: World Inside Product
commands.desc: Symbolic brand world appears inside or through the product form.
commands.instruction: Reveal an imaginative campaign world inside or through the visual volume of the product while preserving its recognizable exterior. Do not invent technical internals.

commands.label: Product Landscape
commands.desc: Brand and packaging cues become terrain and spatial geography.
commands.instruction: Let product shapes, colors or brand cues inspire terrain, paths, cliffs, platforms or gardens while keeping the exact hero product clearly visible and readable.

commands.label: Surreal Scale
commands.desc: Huge and tiny objects interact in one photographic campaign world.
commands.instruction: Create a single readable surreal-scale relationship between the exact product and unusually large or tiny people, objects or environments. Sell the illusion with strong perspective and scale cues.

commands.label: Gravity Defying
commands.desc: Impossible balance or levitation used as a campaign metaphor.
commands.instruction: Use suspension, impossible balance or controlled levitation as the core advertising idea. Keep weight, shadows and spatial choreography believable; avoid a generic centered floating-product layout.

commands.label: Hanging Installation
commands.desc: Product suspended from a believable support system.
commands.instruction: Suspend the exact product from a crane, cable, facade, gallery rig, bridge, transport structure or other believable support. Show attachment points, tension, gravity and shadows.

commands.label: Giant Hand Interaction
commands.desc: Oversized realistic hand places, pulls, opens or reveals the product.
commands.instruction: Use a large realistic hand or controlled human gesture as the main spatial device. Keep anatomy, grip, contact, shadows and scale convincing and make the gesture communicate the idea instantly.

commands.label: Character × Product
commands.desc: Adult human, mascot or original generic character interacts with product.
commands.instruction: Create a static character-interaction campaign using an adult human, supplied mascot or original generic character. Make pose, action and scale tell one clear story while preserving product accuracy.

commands.label: Ingredient / Flavor World
commands.desc: Verified ingredients or flavor cues become an immersive CGI world.
commands.instruction: Build a rich ingredient/flavor environment using only ingredients, flavors or sensory cues visible in current references or explicitly supplied. Never invent ingredients or nutrition claims.

commands.label: Food Story CGI
commands.desc: Dish or beverage becomes a cinematic 3D storytelling scene.
commands.instruction: Turn the current food/beverage into one premium story scene using scale, steam, utensils, architecture, miniature activity or verified ingredients as appropriate. Avoid generic splash-only advertising.

commands.label: Typography as Architecture
commands.desc: Brand text or short headline becomes a spatial 3D structure.
commands.instruction: Turn supplied brand text or a short non-factual headline into dimensional walls, ramps, paths or sculptural architecture interacting with the exact product. Keep text legible.

commands.label: Product Portal
commands.desc: Product connects two distinct worlds through a dimensional portal.
commands.instruction: Use a believable portal to connect two brand-relevant environments. Keep portal depth, edge light, occlusion and reflections coherent while preserving the exact product.

commands.label: Product Journey
commands.desc: One visual scene suggests a clear branded journey or transformation of context.
commands.instruction: Stage the exact product along a route, track, path, travel system or sequence of environmental cues that implies a journey in one static key visual without becoming a storyboard.

commands.label: Brand Monument
commands.desc: Product or logo becomes a monumental public sculpture.
commands.instruction: Create a premium monumental sculpture derived from the product or brand symbol in a believable public, architectural or landscape setting. Use realistic structural support and human scale.

commands.label: Category Metaphor
commands.desc: Translate the product category into one unexpected physical world.
commands.instruction: Infer the current category and create one strong non-factual visual metaphor from it—speed, freshness, comfort, precision, indulgence, ritual, etc.—without inventing performance claims.

commands.label: Surprise CGI Concept
commands.desc: Automatically choose the strongest unexpected commercial CGI mechanism.
commands.instruction: Infer current brand/category cues and choose one unexpected but commercially relevant static CGI concept not already implied by the brief. Prioritize memorability and brand fit over trendy effects.
